name: Memory Trails 1.4 (Build 9)
body:
Memory Trails 1.4 for macOS.
Build: 9

Highlights:
- Memory Trails 1.4 promotes the polished 1.3 feature set into a new major point release with a cleaner, release-style What’s New experience.
- Outlook capture includes the latest Classic and New Outlook reliability improvements, support for column and non-column layouts, calendar invitations, sender-aware timeline entries, and stronger protection against Outlook UI chrome being logged as email data.
- Today & Timeline include the restored details experience, Go to Today, clearer activity presentation, and improved app-name handling.
- Ask Memory Trails returns uncapped matching Supporting Activity, includes Back to Top navigation, clearer quick-start icons, and expanded activity Close controls.
- Insights, Favorites, Clipboard History, Storage/History/Export, Settings, update handling, and privacy-first local processing refinements are included.
- Version 1.4 remains local-first: no cloud timeline sync, external data connectors, advertising SDKs, or AI timeline summarization.


Privacy:
- Captured activity is sourced, processed, and stored locally on the Mac.
- No cloud timeline sync.
- No external data connectors.
- No analytics or advertising SDKs.
- No Memory Trails account or remote account is required.
- Captured timeline data is not transmitted to an external service.
- Passwords and Wallet are excluded by default.
- Clipboard capture can be disabled at any time.
- Apps and processes can be excluded from capture.
- Source code is available in this repository for review and verification.
- Memory Trails does not generate AI summaries of the timeline.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Detailed window/activity capture requires Accessibility permission.

This automated build uses ad-hoc signing when a Developer ID certificate is not configured and is not notarized in that case.
